lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular, high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a coordinate-like visual matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear horizontal feature running across the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-10 small high-luminance blobs distributed across the lower and middle surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct yellow-pigmented pixel cluster is visible superior to the pectoral fin base; high-density spotting pattern present on the distal surface of the pectoral fin.
